selection_rule: single run; compare source drift across predeclared wind-scale settings
truth_isolation: the start and perturbation settings use no source truth
baseline_reuse: the 0.25 setting reuses the heuristic run from the frozen 12x6 development matrix when all input, code, seed, epoch, q-mode, source-mode, and physics hashes match
prohibitions: do not choose perturbation settings using source truth
do not tune a deployment threshold on development
do not interpret source drift as a calibrated confidence interval
